release.commit_subject: Fable red-team review of v1.4 Sessions 2-5: 6 defects fixed w/ regression tests
release.note: binaries were cut AFTER the review fixes, so every acceptance scenario below exercises the fixed code — including the four fixes (contract-hash-bound override, one-shot ask approve, blocking-assay transcript completeness, tolerance-checked container removal) that changed the very behaviors being proven

review_pass.scope: full red-team of Session 2 (8e282bb), Session 3 (d369f9a), Session 4 (d2b42e0), Session 5 (4ee29b1), Session 6 (1675c32)
defects_found_and_fixed: containment override signature bound only job_id:reason — survived arbitrary edits to the contract body; now binds the contract hash (containment block cleared), new `gov containment message` prints the exact bytes to sign
complete-transcript enforcement was fail-open: blocking-assay (evidence-bearing) runs needed the explicit opt-in flag, and an Observe error skipped the check even WITH the flag

DockerRunner.Destroy and the workspace_destroy reconcile dispatch swallowed every docker rm failure — a daemon-down retry marked the teardown done while the container lived; runner.RemoveContainer now tolerates only the already-gone case
bare `gov ask approve` (approve once) was a functional no-op — resolved the checkpoint, wrote no override, the re-run re-ASKed; now a real single-use override (policy_overrides.one_shot/consumed_at)
policy rule condition fields were never validated against the fact vocabulary — a typo'd DENY rule silently never fired, forever

docker.egress_allowlist was a silently-unenforced security control (documented as a restriction, mapped to no docker flag) and IsHardened ignored network entirely — allowlist now rejected fail-closed, hardened requires network: deny
review_pass.additional_sweep: deferred quota.Release failure now queued as quota_release outbox work
review_pass.gate: go build/vet/test -race green repo-wide, gofmt clean, at 9c25e43

2_containment_signed_override_passes_gat.mechanism: operator ed25519 keypair; `gov containment message <job.yaml> --reason ...` printed `<job_id>:<contract_hash>:<reason>`; signature placed in containment.override_signature; config containment.override_public_key set
2_containment_signed_override_passes_gat.outcome: containment gate PASSED (run proceeded to launch and failed later as BINARY_MISSING on a deliberately nonexistent glm bin — an infra failure, not a containment refusal), proving the override verified
2_containment_signed_override_passes_gat.bonus_organic_evidence: this BINARY_MISSING failure opened the glm circuit breaker, observed on the next run as 'warning: backend glm breaker is OPEN'

3_containment_override_tamper_refused.outcome: gov run exited 1 pre-launch with the containment error again — the signature binds the contract hash, so ANY body edit invalidates the override (the review-pass fix, proven live in the rebuilt binary)
